about: Node-side outputs for the K9 node shell (FoodCourtSim). Each entry says where it came from. The engine fills in node names, IPs, times, PIDs, hashes and sizes (src/engine/foodcourt-sim/node/fixtures.ts). Refresh with the manual workflow .github/workflows/capture-cka.yml, then `npx tsx scripts/capture-cka/import.ts <artifact.json>` (entries become source "kind-capture").

sources.node-image: Real output, recorded 2026-11-01 inside the kind node image kindest/node:v1.37.0@sha256:a1ed56cfb0e7b93589bdf97c8cd566405a265939e3620fc4f5de89adff580ae5 (Kubernetes v1.37.0, systemd 257, crictl 1.36.0, containerd 2.3.4) after kubeadm init with kind's settings, on a cgroup v1 host where the control plane could not start. Format and wording are real; cluster-dependent lines are replaced by kind-capture. The kubectl-in-* entries ran the image's own kubectl v1.37.0 (see each note).
sources.etcd-image: Real output of etcdctl/etcdutl 3.7.0 (registry.k8s.io/etcd:3.7.0-0, the image kubeadm v1.37.0 uses), recorded 2026-11-01 against a real etcd 3.7.0 with the kubeadm-made certificates.
sources.kubectl-client: Real output of kubectl v1.37.2 against a closed API port, recorded 2026-11-01.
sources.component-image: Real output of registry.k8s.io/kube-scheduler:v1.37.0 started with the given flags, recorded 2026-11-01.
sources.docs: From an official documentation example (link in "ref"): replace with kind-capture.
sources.kind-capture: Captured on a real 3-node kind cluster by .github/workflows/capture-cka.yml.

etcdctl-snapshot-usage.text:
Manages etcd node snapshots

Usage:
  etcdctl snapshot [command]

Examples:
  # Save snapshot to a given file
  etcdctl snapshot save /backup/etcd-snapshot.db
  
  # Get snapshot from given address and save it to file
  etcdctl snapshot save --endpoints=127.0.0.1:3000 /backup/etcd-snapshot.db
  
  # Get snapshot from given address with certificates
  etcdctl --endpoints=https://127.0.0.1:2379 --cacert=/etc/etcd/ca.crt --cert=/etc/etcd/etcd.crt --key=/etc/etcd/etcd.key snapshot save /backup/etcd-snapshot.db
  
  # Get snapshot with certain user and password
  etcdctl --user=root --password=password123 snapshot save /backup/etcd-snapshot.db
  
  # Get snapshot from given address with timeout
  etcdctl --endpoints=https://127.0.0.1:2379 --dial-timeout=20s snapshot save /backup/etcd-snapshot.db
  
  # Save snapshot with desirable time format
  etcdctl snapshot save /mnt/backup/etcd/backup_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).db

Available Commands:
  save        Stores an etcd node backend snapshot to a given file

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for snapshot

Use "etcdctl snapshot [command] --help" for more information about a command.
Use "etcdctl options" for a list of global command-line options (applies to all commands).

[Service]
# On cgroup v1, the /kubelet cgroup is created in the entrypoint script before running systemd.
# On cgroup v2, the /kubelet cgroup is created here. (See the comments in the entrypoint script for the reason.)
ExecStartPre=/bin/sh -euc "if [ -f /sys/fs/cgroup/cgroup.controllers ]; then /kind/bin/create-kubelet-cgroup-v2.sh; fi"
# on WSL2 (and potentially other distros without systemd) /sys/fs/cgroup/systemd is created after the entrypoint, during /sbin/init.
# This eventually leads to kubelet failing to start, see: https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kind/issues/2323
ExecStartPre=/bin/sh -euc "if [ ! -f /sys/fs/cgroup/cgroup.controllers ] && [ ! -d /sys/fs/cgroup/systemd/kubelet ]; then mkdir -p /sys/fs/cgroup/systemd/kubelet; fi"
